plain_text:
The character limit will be displayed under the text field for sections of the APR that need text
responses (see fig. 13). Review the text field for accuracy when copying and pasting chunks of
data, as the content will be truncated once the character limit is reached.

plain_text:
NOTE! Text entered in description fields will be saved as plain text and will not accept
formatting.
semantic_text: NOTE! Text entered in description fields will be saved as plain text and will not accept formatting.

plain_text:
Fields that collect percentages will allow only a numeric value (i.e., alpha characters cannot be
entered in a numeric field). A validation error will be displayed if the data type formats are not
entered correctly. If this happens, the data on the page may not be saved. To avoid losing work,
correct these before navigating away from the page.

Select the Yes or No option to respond (see fig. 14).
